message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Genre | Notable Facts |
|-------|----------------|-------|---------------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | Fantasy | First book in the Harry Potter series; introduced the world of Hogwarts. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Fantasy | Introduces the mystery of the Chamber and the Basilisk. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Fantasy | Features Sirius Black and the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Fantasy | The Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Fantasy | Focuses on Dumbledore’s Army and the Ministry’s interference. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince** | 2005 | Fantasy | Explores Voldemort’s backstory and the Horcrux quest. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Fantasy | Concludes the epic saga with the Battle of Hogwarts. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Contemporary Fiction | Rowling’s first adult novel, dealing with small‑town politics. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Crime/Thriller | Debut of the Cormoran Strike detective series. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Crime/Thriller | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Crime/Thriller | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Crime/Thriller | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |

These titles have been bestsellers worldwide, received critical acclaim, and have been adapted into major film franchises (for the Harry Potter books). If you’d like more details about any particular book or want recommendations based on your interests, let me know!
